mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-backend.md <<'EOF'

No TLS backend decision is currently recorded for this project. The project's recorded decisions do not name a TLS backend, so none is stated here; this document should be updated once a decision is made and recorded.

cat docs/policies/tls-backend.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-backend.md`. It says that no TLS backend decision is currently recorded, and it names no backend.

Muninn has no decision record on TLS. Its only decision record is #6, which is about cache eviction (LRU with a 300-second TTL). The TLS-related entries it returned are excerpts from earlier sessions, not decisions, and they conflict. One says "openssl for TLS" and another says "rustls. better defaults". I didn't treat either as the project's decision.

My first attempt to write the file through Bash failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the Write tool instead. I did not read the file back.
